narrative: The letter, open. The letter, written down to one question, and empty under it. The pen is set down. No second page. The letter, open. A blank below the barn line, wide enough for a yes or a no. The thimble is not on this leaf. The pen is set down.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Set the pen down under the barn line.

entities.name: letter
